name: switch
title: Switch
description: An on/off switch on Base UI's Switch: a track that fills with the accent solid and a sliding thumb, in three sizes.

manifest.name: switch
manifest.title: Switch
manifest.description: An on/off switch on Base UI's Switch: a track that fills with the accent solid and a sliding thumb, in three sizes.
manifest.usage: Use Switch for a setting that takes effect as soon as it is flipped ("Auto-commit", "Read-only connection"), in settings panels and side panels. Wrap it in a FieldLabel with its text (the text may come first) inside a Field, and add a FieldDescription for what it does; group related switches in a FieldSet with a FieldLegend. With TanStack Form wire checked, onCheckedChange and onBlur to the field. For a choice that only applies when a form is submitted, use Checkbox; for a toolbar toggle, ToggleButton.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called when the user flips it.

props.name: size
props.description: Thumb size from size.icon.xs, sm or md; the track is two thumbs wide.

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name of the hidden input; a Field's name wins.

props.name: required
props.description: Must be on before the form submits.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The track, role="switch"; data-slot="switch", data-size, data-checked. A hidden <input type="checkbox"> follows it.

slots.name: thumb
slots.description: The sliding thumb in color.bg.surface with elevation; data-slot="switch-thumb".

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer over an on switch: the accent solid's hover colour.

states.name: checked
states.description: On: the accent solid track, the thumb at the end.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus: a ring of ring.width in color.ring.

states.name: invalid
states.description: In an invalid Field, while off: a color.status.danger.border track.

accessibility: Renders a <span role="switch"> with aria-checked and a hidden native input for forms; Tab reaches it, Space and Enter flip it.

Label it by wrapping it in a FieldLabel with its text; the text flips it too and enlarges the target beyond the track (WCAG 2.2 target size). Name the setting, not the state ("Auto-commit", not "Auto-commit on").
On and off differ by the thumb's position as well as the track colour; the off track is color.border.strong (3:1 against the surface).
The thumb slides in the reading direction (right in LTR, left in RTL).
Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring (3:1 on every surface).

meta.example:
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldLabel, FieldLegend, FieldSet } from "@/components/field/field";
import { Switch } from "@/components/switch/switch";

/** The smallest useful Switch: one setting with its label. */
export function SwitchMinimal() {
  return (
    <Field>
      <FieldLabel>
        <Switch />
        Read-only connection
      </FieldLabel>
    </Field>
  );
}

/**
 * Connection settings: switches with descriptions, text before the switch, a setting the workspace
 * locks, and the small and large sizes.
 */
export function SwitchRealistic() {
  return (
    <FieldSet>
      <FieldLegend>Session</FieldLegend>
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel>
          <Switch defaultChecked />
          Auto-commit
        </FieldLabel>
        <FieldDescription>Commit every statement as soon as it runs.</FieldDescription>
      </Field>
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel className="w-full justify-between">
          Keep the connection alive
          <Switch size="sm" />
        </FieldLabel>
      </Field>
      <Field disabled>
        <FieldLabel>
          <Switch defaultChecked />
          Read-only connection
        </FieldLabel>
        <FieldDescription>Set by the workspace administrator.</FieldDescription>
      </Field>
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel className="text-body">
          <Switch size="lg" />
          Show query plans
        </FieldLabel>
      </Field>
    </FieldSet>
  );
}
